question: Can three materially orthogonal null frameworks (model-based parametric bootstrap, Miller-Madow unbiased PMI estimator, conditional entropy H) center the null at zero for hash-routed SPAs with deterministic/stochastic strata mixing, resolving the inherited ~0.41-bit PMI estimator bias floor that within-stratum permutation cannot eliminate?
hypothesis: H1 (parametric bootstrap): A model-based null — estimate P(url_after | url_before, history) from data, simulate null transition samples from this estimated distribution, compute PMI on each simulated dataset — yields null mean PMI within [-0.1, +0.1] bits of zero at K=2 on the 12-state SPA simulation with N=5000, resolving the inherited C4 failure (within-stratum permutation null_mean=0.417). H2 (Miller-Madow): The Miller-Madow bias-corrected PMI estimator (standard PMI + (V-1)/(2Nln2) where V is vocabulary size) reduces the finite-sample bias such that the within-stratum permutation null mean is within [-0.1, +0.1] bits of zero. H3 (conditional entropy): Conditional entropy H(url_after | action, url_before, history) minus H(url_after | url_before, history) — the information-theoretic analogue of PMI without estimator weighting — yields null-distribution mean within [-0.1, +0.1] bits under within-stratum permutation, and the observed value exceeds the null.
falsifier: Primary: ALL three frameworks yield null mean outside [-0.1, +0.1] bits of zero on the 12-state SPA at N=5000 K=2. If any single framework centers the null, it is considered a valid null for subsequent production testing. Secondary (conditional on any framework centering null): K2 PMI (or conditional entropy analogue) is <= 0.05 bits on the 12-state SPA (beyond-Markov signal absent under validated null).
baselines: Parent result: within-stratum conditional permutation null_mean=0.417 bits at K2 on 12-state SPA N=5000 (EXP-PHYSICS-35389142077) — the inherited C4 failure
Parent result: state-history K2 PMI=0.933 bits (p=0.001, d=79.7) at N=5000 on 12-state SPA — the signal to be re-measured
Parent result: action-shuffle null_mean=0.406 bits — converges with within-stratum, confirming estimator-weighting property
Parent result: block permutation null_mean=0.552 bits — known biased baseline
Positive control: 8-state synthetic deterministic SPA N=5000, K3 PMI >= 1.0 bits with p < 0.001
Unconditional K0 PMI reproduction (should be ~1.42 bits)
K1 state-history PMI reproduction (should be ~1.53 bits)
positive_control: 8-state synthetic deterministic SPA with known beyond-Markov structure (same as parent). K=3 PMI must be >= 1.0 bits with permutation p < 0.001. Validates PMI pipeline at N=5000. Additionally, conditional entropy positive control: H(S_next|S,H_K=3) > H(S_next|S,H_K=2) on the same 8-state SPA (history adds information).
null_control:
Three independent null frameworks applied to the same 12-state SPA K2 data:

1. Parametric bootstrap null: (a) Estimate transition model P_hat(url_after | url_before, history) from observed data using maximum likelihood with Laplace smoothing for unseen strata. (b) For each permutation, simulate N=5000 transitions from this estimated model, keeping (url_before, history) keys fixed and drawing url_after from P_hat. (c) Compute PMI on each simulated dataset. (d) 1000 bootstrap samples, seed=42. Expected null mean = 0 bits because simulated transitions respect the estimated conditional distribution, breaking action-PMI coupling while preserving stratum structure.

2. Miller-Madow corrected PMI: Apply the Miller-Madow bias correction to the standard PMI estimator: PMI_MM(x,y) = PMI(x,y) + (V_x - 1)/(2*N_x*ln(2)) + (V_y - 1)/(2*N_y*ln(2)) - (V_xy - 1)/(2*N_xy*ln(2)), where V is effective vocabulary size and N is sample count for each marginal/conditional. Recompute within-stratum permutation null with corrected estimator. Expected: finite-sample bias reduced, null mean closer to zero.

3. Conditional entropy difference: Compute DeltaH = H(url_after | action, url_before, history) - H(url_after | url_before, history) under the observed data and under within-stratum permutation null. Expected: null DeltaH mean = 0 (permutation breaks action coupling), observed DeltaH > 0 if beyond-Markov structure exists.
measurement_validity: N=5000 transitions from 12-state SPA simulation (in-memory, same as parent)
State-history H_K built from URL states (prev1, prev2, ...) with START_TOKEN padding
PMI pipeline with alpha=0 smoothing, MIN_STRATUM_SIZE=5 (same as parent)
Parametric bootstrap uses maximum likelihood with Laplace smoothing (alpha=1.0) for zero-count strata
Miller-Madow correction uses effective vocabulary size from observed unique tokens in each marginal/conditional
Conditional entropy estimated via plug-in estimator with Laplace smoothing
All three frameworks tested on the identical K2 transition dataset (same seed=42, same 5000 transitions)
Within-stratum conditional permutation: 1000 perms per framework, seed=42, Bonferroni alpha=0.0167 for 3 frameworks
Non-leakage filter: exclude transitions where action.target_href == state_after.url (same definition as parent)
decision_rule:
Each framework is evaluated independently against the same criterion: |null_mean| < 0.1 bits at K=2 on the 12-state SPA N=5000.

Framework PASS conditions:
- Parametric bootstrap: |bootstrap_null_mean_K2| < 0.1 bits AND positive control passes (K3 PMI >= 1.0 bits, p < 0.001) AND K2 PMI > 0.05 bits
- Miller-Madow: |mm_null_mean_K2| < 0.1 bits AND positive control passes AND K2_PMIMM > 0.05 bits
- Conditional entropy: |deltah_null_mean_K2| < 0.1 bits AND positive control passes AND deltaH_observed > 0.05 bits

Overall verdict:
- SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST if >= 1/3 frameworks passes all conditions (any one framework centers null with signal detected)
- FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING if 0/3 frameworks pass (all three fail to center null)
- MEASUREMENT_INVALID if positive control fails on any framework (pipeline broken) or data quality insufficient
product_consequence_positive: C-WEB-DYNAMICS advances from HYPOTHESIS toward EXPERIMENTAL. At least one validated null framework resolves the inherited C4 failure, enabling production SPA testing with a measurement-valid null. The validated framework becomes the standard null control for subsequent Physics experiments.
product_consequence_negative: If all three frameworks fail: the null control problem may be intrinsic to hash-routed SPA design with deterministic/stochastic mixing at N=5000. The Physics lane should pivot to the orthogonal high-upside question: whether the 0.933-bit K2 PMI signal is primarily Markov (action determines next state given current state) or genuinely beyond-Markov (history adds information beyond current state), using action-history K3 as baseline comparison at same N. This pivot does not close C-WEB-DYNAMICS but redirects the detection strategy from null centering to signal decomposition.
estimated_cost: Low: single local computation on in-memory 12-state SPA simulation. Three null frameworks with 1000 permutations each, N=5000 transitions. Estimated ~10-15 minutes total. No browser, no network, no external dependencies.
expected_information_gain: Very high: directly resolves the single most actionable inherited methodology defect (null control bias). If any framework centers null, the entire PMI pipeline becomes measurement-valid for hash-routed SPAs, unblocking all subsequent Physics claims. If all fail, the lane pivots with clear rationale. Either outcome materially changes the Physics lane's trajectory. This is the highest-information-gain experiment available given the current inherited state.
